name: peros-esports
description: Peros Esports - Where Every Clutch Counts!

scripts.prepare-www: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('www', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('assets')) fs.cpSync('assets', 'www/assets', {recursive:true, force:true}); ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','sfx.js','particles.js','manifest.json','sw.js','peros-logo.png','peros-logo.jpg'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f); }); console.log('WWW prepared successfully!');"
scripts.cap:build: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync android
